There is no single clinically proven "best" dihydromyricetin (DHM) supplement, as large-scale double-blind clinical trials on DHM for hangovers remain limited . However, several popular options stand out based on ingredient transparency, third-party testing, and formulation style:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF100TlIqsmUz08NGAgA0WYP4RgxfYal-yZlgVaAyCRiqareIrD1eHjj4QVH2eAlbMjPKnyWTk8Ewa-lPZKrkiA94dsVNta4bxE4U1xc8Dh6gRCJZ8F9oktqccIpJR4nfVqiicklUadoGlas4NA35RvB136Jqs0MFsWCXCsKmVYXcuYrA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXL0zANFiP6oD_BM2UKqejS_CvuUHLXYK1yz6_t-yVxRMQEZAN2uFujh1fmVsQF52mynd_uJo_nilNXLcOqwtKmUqtRrRV-uvcEMzCXQyyASKZ3hkN5XsTfzICBtWqHOsEku6h4y8zuKLl9_DU6sgSea-KOtgJkQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXX8vGs-p339EeoBnF_uDNd3GocVtL_KxhE52J2phLVHTlMtXiicyTyyZNknINHpUPiAK1OMWPrT8Ckf-_R3i_Am3HKNehA3MuIaV5Y2-tLXXq-__yb1QgnLFsbXXXzTSMQ)

- **Standalone DHM:** [Double Wood Dihydromyricetin (DHM)](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11aJbaZhWl6EIIJHAVAI3wAQMatPlNNEK_4NckA27NGF0YGv0LHZeSxC8y0u2y8YoOxX9I76Wnl18a0PzHY2A6hdOpVoXPpQbVJFaD8B8nz6ajRDE_5LCXPpRzyqYgpNWAga1FrKQXfNsZxublar4tH7YY-2hF4DylboDQ) provides 300 mg of DHM per capsule (90 capsules for $24.95) and is manufactured and third-party tested in the USA. It works well if you want a straightforward dose without extra blends. Other common standalone or pure-focused brands include Nutricost and DHM Depot.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXX6JjWQBw7TmfdSEIFg0UXhVDd_iV6c05HosAY4i5GMLwCbESHG5P78_stCV7NSpL-nCgDNVwiHcFHZiZ9MhJeDakUDI4mdTIkA1ybjUXtcTNmIRf6DcDl2B-SEQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11aJbaZhWl6EIIJHAVAI3wAQMatPlNNEK_4NckA27NGF0YGv0LHZeSxC8y0u2y8YoOxX9I76Wnl18a0PzHY2A6hdOpVoXPpQbVJFaD8B8nz6ajRDE_5LCXPpRzyqYgpNWAga1FrKQXfNsZxublar4tH7YY-2hF4DylboDQ)
- **Multi-Ingredient Recovery Blends:** Many popular formulas pair DHM with liver-support compounds, electrolytes, or B vitamins—such as Cheers Restore, Flyby Recovery Pills, H-PROOF, and Morning Recovery. According to coverage from [WIRED](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXL0zANFiP6oD_BM2UKqejS_CvuUHLXYK1yz6_t-yVxRMQEZAN2uFujh1fmVsQF52mynd_uJo_nilNXLcOqwtKmUqtRrRV-uvcEMzCXQyyASKZ3hkN5XsTfzICBtWqHOsEku6h4y8zuKLl9_DU6sgSea-KOtgJkQ) and [TIME](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF100TlIqsmUz08NGAgA0WYP4RgxfYal-yZlgVaAyCRiqareIrD1eHjj4QVH2eAlbMjPKnyWTk8Ewa-lPZKrkiA94dsVNta4bxE4U1xc8Dh6gRCJZ8F9oktqccIpJR4nfVqiicklUadoGlas4NA35RvB136Jqs0MFsWCXCsKmVYXcuYrA) , experts note that evidence for hangover pills is limited, making hydration, nutrition, and moderation the most reliable strategies.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXL0zANFiP6oD_BM2UKqejS_CvuUHLXYK1yz6_t-yVxRMQEZAN2uFujh1fmVsQF52mynd_uJo_nilNXLcOqwtKmUqtRrRV-uvcEMzCXQyyASKZ3hkN5XsTfzICBtWqHOsEku6h4y8zuKLl9_DU6sgSea-KOtgJkQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX5StyaGDc2Xm4PAXXux9peFSnwe5ldCfUPXpYjCIf-dw94ek6LTQyyAvyX9PWmDRv0wXdC_X9GzpjODAYISjfb6H7MW30Vy7yRe5FPkwaHY_RoaypVlvISn2g4W_QvCBdBLlfAOPYCQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF100TlIqsmUz08NGAgA0WYP4RgxfYal-yZlgVaAyCRiqareIrD1eHjj4QVH2eAlbMjPKnyWTk8Ewa-lPZKrkiA94dsVNta4bxE4U1xc8Dh6gRCJZ8F9oktqccIpJR4nfVqiicklUadoGlas4NA35RvB136Jqs0MFsWCXCsKmVYXcuYrA)

### What to Look For When Choosing

- **Third-party testing:** Supplements are not tightly pre-approved for efficacy, so independent testing helps verify label accuracy and purity.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11aJbaZhWl6EIIJHAVAI3wAQMatPlNNEK_4NckA27NGF0YGv0LHZeSxC8y0u2y8YoOxX9I76Wnl18a0PzHY2A6hdOpVoXPpQbVJFaD8B8nz6ajRDE_5LCXPpRzyqYgpNWAga1FrKQXfNsZxublar4tH7YY-2hF4DylboDQ)
- **Clear DHM dosage:** Check the supplement facts label for the exact milligram amount of DHM rather than relying on proprietary blends.
- **Added ingredients:** Decide whether you want pure DHM or a formula with electrolytes, NAC, milk thistle, or B vitamins.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXX6JjWQBw7TmfdSEIFg0UXhVDd_iV6c05HosAY4i5GMLwCbESHG5P78_stCV7NSpL-nCgDNVwiHcFHZiZ9MhJeDakUDI4mdTIkA1ybjUXtcTNmIRf6DcDl2B-SEQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11aJbaZhWl6EIIJHAVAI3wAQMatPlNNEK_4NckA27NGF0YGv0LHZeSxC8y0u2y8YoOxX9I76Wnl18a0PzHY2A6hdOpVoXPpQbVJFaD8B8nz6ajRDE_5LCXPpRzyqYgpNWAga1FrKQXfNsZxublar4tH7YY-2hF4DylboDQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX5StyaGDc2Xm4PAXXux9peFSnwe5ldCfUPXpYjCIf-dw94ek6LTQyyAvyX9PWmDRv0wXdC_X9GzpjODAYISjfb6H7MW30Vy7yRe5FPkwaHY_RoaypVlvISn2g4W_QvCBdBLlfAOPYCQ)
